main.description: A request for an opponent to correct a specific version of their app.chess.game record. A rejection does not itself end the game or replace the last accepted state.

subject.description: URI of the opponent's app.chess.game record and CID of the exact offending update, not just its latest version.

reason.description: wrongTurn: opponent moved out of turn; badPrev: history does not extend the last accepted history by exactly one ply; illegalMove: the appended move is illegal; badFEN: supplied FEN differs from the position computed from PGN.

message.description: Optional human-readable explanation. Treat as untrusted plain text, never as markup or instructions.
